sample_unit: standardized discharge scenarios (rated by 15 clinical experts and 38 patients)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated discharge instructions versus nurse-written, rated by patients and NLP
links.effect: Nurses significantly outperformed AI in readability; NLP analysis showed AI texts had higher syntactic complexity and terminology density.
links.quote: Nurses significantly outperformed AI in both empathy and readability, and objective NLP analysis confirmed that AI-generated texts exhibited higher syntactic complexity and terminology density.

links.outcome: Clinical safety risks in GPT-4 generated discharge instructions identified by expert reviewers
links.effect: Experts identified safety risks in AI-generated texts, whereas no such issues were found in nurse-produced texts.
links.quote: AI outperformed nurses in information comprehensiveness, but experts identified safety risks in AI-generated texts, whereas no such issues were found in nurse-produced texts.

screen.reason: The study empirically compares GPT-4 generated discharge instructions against nurse-generated instructions on standardized vignettes, evaluated by clinical experts and patients, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
